caption: The report opens inside an indoor volleyball training hall with a teal-blue floor and pink court zones. Two coaches in red T-shirts and black shorts stand near the net (one by the left post holding a yellow-and-blue Mikasa ball, one mid-court), a player in a black sleeveless jersey with knee pads walks toward the net, and a woman in black holds a ball at the right post beside two blue MIKASA ball carts. The shot cuts to a closer net view where players in black sleeveless tops jump with arms raised to block; the white net tape reads "TOKYO VOLLEYBALL QUALIFICATION" with the FIVB logo. A female Mandarin narrator introduces the story over ambient gym sounds.
visual: Light-blue walls, gray upper paneling, red banner top-left with white characters ending in "道"; "CCTV 5 体育" logo top-left; "BuSim bilibili" watermark bottom-left; blue "Senoh" post pads; yellow-blue Mikasa balls; black sleeveless practice jerseys vs red coach shirts; handheld camera with slight pan at the net.
audio: Female Mandarin voice-over narration; diegetic gym ambience (ball bounces, faint calls, shoe squeaks); no prominent music.
speech: Narrator: The Chinese men's volleyball team has announced a 30-player training roster; starting April 6, the players are divided into three batches arriving in Beilun for training.

caption: A player in a black sleeveless jersey cradles a yellow-blue ball, looks upward, tosses and executes a jump serve; the camera tilts up tracking the ball against gray wall panels and windows. The view widens to reveal the large multi-court hall: numerous players in black and red spread across several nets, some staff seated on benches along the wall, loose balls scattered on the floor, and blue "北仑" signage high on the far wall.
visual: Serve motion (toss, arm swing, landing); wide establishing shot of gym with multiple nets, bleachers, benches, scattered balls; blue Chinese characters "北仑" on upper wall; persistent CCTV5 and bilibili overlays.
audio: Narration continues; sharp ball-contact thud on the serve, sneaker squeaks, distant voices.
speech: Narrator: On April 13 the second batch reported, and appropriate adjustments were made to the first batch; currently 20 players are in the training lineup.

caption: Cut to a medium close-up interview of head coach Vital Heynen, an older Caucasian man with short white hair in a red Adidas T-shirt with black shoulder stripes, speaking into a microphone whose white cube flag reads "中国中央电视台" with the CCTV logo. Behind him hang the Chinese national flag and a red banner reading "Only winning counts / 一切为赢"; empty bleachers and a net fill the background. A lower-third graphic identifies him.
visual: Interview framing, red shirt with Adidas logo, mic flag text, banner "Only winning counts 一切为赢", national flag, bleachers; lower third: "维塔尔·海宁 / 中国男排主教练".
audio: Heynen's English audible beneath a male Mandarin translation voice-over; quiet indoor room tone.
speech: Heynen (via translator): The reason the training roster is split into three batches is simple—about ten new players have joined.

caption: Training B-roll resumes: players in black perform block-and-attack repetitions at the taped net while red-shirted coaches watch. The scene then shows Heynen in red standing beside a younger Asian assistant in a matching red shirt in front of folded bleachers and the blue "北仑" sign; Heynen demonstrates tactics with both hands—palms facing each other moving apart and together, then clasping—while the assistant mirrors the gestures; a player in black crosses the foreground.
visual: Net drills (jumping, arm swings); two-man demonstration with hand gestures; folded gray bleachers; blue "北仑" wall sign; red shirts with black stripes.
audio: Translator voice-over continues over gym ambience (ball hits, calls).
speech: Translator for Heynen: I want to look at their situation first. Among the first batch there are also players who need overseas [treatment]; the players I know better are concentrated in the second batch; in this way we gradually build the team.

caption: Return to the Heynen interview close-up. He speaks expressively, raising his left arm outward and upward to emphasize a point; a person in red walks through the background near the banner and flag.
visual: Same interview setup; animated arm gesture; banner "Only winning counts 一切为赢"; national flag; passer-by in red behind.
audio: Male Mandarin translator voice-over over Heynen's English; room tone.
speech: Translator for Heynen: The third batch consists of players who are playing overseas. I miss them very much, but we still need to wait patiently.

caption: Net-level footage focuses on setter Yu Yaochen, a tall player in a black long-sleeve compression top and black shorts, moving along the tape-marked net and playing overhead sets/passes with yellow-blue balls; teammates in black sleeveless jerseys surround him; a blue Senoh-padded post with the FIVB logo and a green ball-return machine appear in the background as the camera tracks laterally.
visual: Long-sleeve black top distinguishing Yu; setting motion (hands above forehead); net tape "TOKYO VOLLEYBALL QUALIFICATION"; FIVB logo on post pad; green machine; blue chairs along wall.
audio: Female narrator returns; crisp ball-contact sounds and player calls.
speech: Narrator: In yesterday's training, the biggest change on the setter line was Yu Yaochen's official return; after several days of recovery and preparation, Yu Yaochen is gradually regaining his form.

caption: Interview with Yu Yaochen, a young Chinese man with short dark hair in a black Adidas T-shirt, holding the CCTV-flagged microphone; lower third reads "于垚辰 / 中国男排队员"; gray brick wall, red banner and flag behind. Around 00:58–01:04 the edit intercuts training footage of Yu (black long-sleeve) exchanging balls with red-shirted coaches on the pink court beside MIKASA carts, then returns to the interview.
visual: Interview close-up with name/title graphic; intercut receiving/setting drills; coaches in red; ball carts; pink court surface.
audio: Yu speaking Mandarin directly to interviewer; gym ambience during B-roll insert.
speech: Yu Yaochen: Last year I was studying in Japan, and there really wasn't training of this intensity. I only rejoined the team the day before yesterday; compared with before, the training intensity isn't that high yet, so I think I can still adapt.

caption: A wide shot framed from behind two blue-and-yellow MIKASA ball carts and a sideline table holding an open laptop showing a live court feed plus a small black device reveals a full-court scrimmage with roughly ten players in black. One player dives for a ball and ends up seated/lying on the pink floor laughing; teammates in black converge, one extending a hand to pull him up, the group smiling. The red wall banner reads "Only winning counts / 一切为赢 / 赢是王道".
visual: Foreground analytics setup (laptop, carts); dive-and-fall moment; helping hand; laughter; full banner text; multiple nets and seated staff in depth.
audio: Narrator over audible laughter, ball strikes and shouts from the court.
speech: Narrator: This year's Chinese men's volleyball squad includes experienced veterans such as Ji Daoshuai anchoring the team and newcomers such as Wu Zhai emerging, presenting a reasonable old–middle–young combined roster structure.

caption: Interview with Ji Daoshuai, a man in a black sleeveless jersey printed "CHINA VOLLEYBALL TEAM" with the Adidas logo; lower third "季道帅 / 中国男排队员"; same gym backdrop with flag and banner. Intercut (~01:24–01:30) with Ji at the net passing and setting yellow-blue balls among teammates and red-shirted coaches, the green ball machine behind.
visual: Sleeveless jersey text "CHINA VOLLEYBALL TEAM"; interview framing; net drill inserts; coaches in red; equipment in background.
audio: Ji speaking Mandarin; gym ambience during inserts.
speech: Ji Daoshuai: It can be said I've adapted; now my physical fitness is gradually recovering. Mainly it's about fitness. The foreign coach also gave me a recovery period; with this recovery period, it doesn't feel especially strenuous.

caption: Interview with Li Yongzhen, another young player in a black sleeveless jersey; lower third "李咏臻 / 中国男排队员". Intercut (~01:39–01:45) with net rotations: players in black jump and spike at the taped net while red-shirted coaches stand on the far side; a wide court view shows multiple nets and seated staff along the walls.
visual: Interview close-up; attacking/blocking reps at net; red coaches opposite; wide multi-court hall; persistent overlays.
audio: Li speaking Mandarin; ball impacts and calls during B-roll.
speech: Li Yongzhen: Today is my third day reporting for training; I feel I've basically entered the normal training rhythm. After coming to the national team this year, the overall offensive rhythm will be played very fast—I think I still need to adapt.

caption: Courtside rehabilitation scene: an elderly white-haired therapist in a red polo bearing a yellow "CHN" flag patch and Adidas logo leans over a player lying supine on a black padded treatment table (black sleeveless top, black shorts, white socks), palpating the player's abdomen and thigh with both hands. Beside them a taller staff member in a red shirt holds a white clipboard displaying a grid of small exercise photographs and wears a black smartwatch; a gray massage device rests near the player's hip. Close-ups show the pressing hands and the therapist's concentrated face; blue "宁波北仑" signage and folded bleachers behind.
visual: Treatment table, supine player, two red-clad staff, photo-grid clipboard, smartwatch, gray massager, CHN patch, blue wall characters "宁波北仑".
audio: Female narrator; soft ambient hall noise.
speech: Narrator: Two new physiotherapy rehabilitation specialists have joined the team; they will help check players' injury conditions at the outset of this men's team's formation, as well as before the World League and the World Championship, carrying out targeted prevention and recovery.

caption: Back to net action: several players in black leap simultaneously at the tape-marked net with arms raised to block/spike beneath the red banner "一切为赢 / 赢是王道". The edit then shows Heynen in red conversing with two players in black near the bleachers, touching his chin/face with one hand as he talks; the players listen attentively.
visual: Multi-player jump at net; banner text; coach-player discussion with gesture; bleachers background.
audio: Narrator bridging to the coach's goal; ball strikes and shouts.
speech: Narrator: Speaking of the World Men's Volleyball League and World Men's Volleyball Championship that the Chinese men's team will enter this year, head coach Heynen has only one goal.

caption: A brief return to the Heynen interview close-up (lower third "维塔尔·海宁 / 中国男排主教练" reappears) leads into a closing training montage: serves, sets and spikes over the net, a player diving and rolling on the pink floor, teammates converging for high-fives and raised-arm celebrations, red-shirted coaches and seated staff along the sidelines, and the sideline laptop/carts glimpsed again. Heynen's translated voice carries over the images to the end.
visual: Interview flash then rapid B-roll: attacks, digs, dives, celebratory gestures at net; full banner "Only winning counts 一切为赢 赢是王道"; CCTV5 and bilibili overlays persist to final frame.
audio: Heynen's English under male Mandarin translator voice-over; energetic gym sounds (ball strikes, cheers); narration absent in this stretch.
speech: Translator for Heynen: My goal is already hung in the venue—that is, winning. Among all the teams participating in this year's World Men's Volleyball League, our ranking is the lowest, so every victory is very important. We want to strive to win more matches and cannot finish last in this year's World Men's Volleyball League.
